extracted.name: Traditional irish soda bread
extracted.description: I've always been one for traditional cultural classics. I've been making this recipe since I was a kid with different variations depending on what ingredients I have. It is so simple yet SO DELICIOUS!! Hope you enjoy:)
instruction_lines: Add all dry ingredients together in a bowl. Mix together
Add buttermilk and raisins. (you can use any dried fruit you'd like or add some yummy seeds):)
Mix together all ingredients, than on a floured surface start needing your bread
Once bread is fully kneaded place on a greased cookie sheet, and slice an X in the top. I then like to graze it with honey as well:)
